name: full-stack-sdet-architect
description: This framework covers all the aspects of QA testing based on nodejs tech.

scripts.pw-run:ui: npx wait-on http://parabank:8080/parabank && npx playwright test --project=ui --shard=1/2
scripts.pw-run:api: npx wait-on http://parabank:8080/parabank && npx playwright test --project=api --shard=2/2
scripts.report:open: docker stop $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=frankescobar/allure-docker-service) 2>/dev/null || true && docker run -it --rm -p 5051:5050 -v $(pwd)/allure-results:/app/allure-results frankescobar/allure-docker-service
